_readme: PRL Max multi-slide and PRL bifold. Every dollar here is PRL's dealer amount to Noble, delivered to Arizona, bronze anodized, freight 0. The app prices the customer from data/rates.json grossMargin the same way Andersen and Milgard do (dealer / (1 - grossMargin)). Do not store the customer price in this file. Installation is the Milgard AX650 schedule in data/milgard-ax650.json and is not part of the product price. Energy Advantage is a multi-slide glass option only. A bifold with that glass, any finish other than bronze anodized, a pocket, a 90-degree corner, 6 or more panels, a bifold screen, or a thermal bifold is not priced.
source: PRL multi-slide and bifold pricing sheet, 2026-11-23
